style: A bold black-and-white screen-print illustration: solid black ink, bright white highlights and a coarse halftone for the mid-tones, crisp edges, high contrast, no color at all. The subject alone, centered, nothing else in frame, no floor and no shadow under it. No text, letters, numbers, or logos.

images.subject: A plain credit card floating at a slight three-quarter angle, its face blank except for a metallic contact chip, rounded corners, a thin glossy edge.
A paper grocery bag standing upright and full of groceries: a baguette, a bunch of leafy greens, a few apples and a glass bottle of milk poking out of the top.
A long paper till receipt curling at both ends, printed with rows of short horizontal dashes in place of any writing, a torn zigzag edge at the bottom.
The front of a grand classical bank building: a triangular pediment over six tall fluted columns, wide stone steps and heavy double doors, seen straight on.
A highway toll booth: a small booth with a canopy roof and a striped barrier arm lowered across the lane, seen from a three-quarter angle.
A countertop card payment terminal with a keypad of round buttons, a small blank screen, and a card slot at the top, seen from a three-quarter angle.
A tall stack of plain coins with ridged edges and two more coins falling onto the top of it.
An hourglass in a turned wooden frame with small coins instead of sand trickling from the top bulb and piling up in the bottom bulb.
A blank cardboard price tag with a round reinforced hole and a loop of string through it, turned slightly.
A glossy ceramic piggy bank standing in profile with a coin slot on its back and one coin dropping into the slot.
A hand holding a modern smartphone upright, the phone's screen blank and glowing white, the fingers wrapped around its edges.
A pair of scissors cutting a plain blank credit card in half, the two halves just separating with a clean cut between them.
A large coin seen almost face-on with a slightly visible ridged edge, its face engraved with a circuit-board pattern of traces and round pads instead of a portrait.
